snippet.title: Everafter Falls - Official Overview Trailer
snippet.description: Everafter Falls is an action-adventure RPG simulation game developed by SquareHusky. Players will execute a variety of tasks from farming to fighting all in the name of restoring peace to the land. Take a look at the latest deep dive for the game going over the dungeons in Everafter Falls. Everafter Falls is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GoG).
